target_customer: Managers at companies who run 1:1s, team meetings and OKRs
problem: Managers ran meetings without agendas, notes or links to goals; Hypercontext tied agendas and action items to OKRs in one workflow.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription per team with a free tier (per product listings)

founders.name: Brennan McEachran
previous_startups: Soapbox (the earlier name of the same product)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists a co-founder and CEO under former founders and no background; a CTO is mentioned in search snippets but not named in sources opened.

exit.reason: Product rebranded and moved into Spinach AI; no sale is described

competitors.name: Fellow
competitors.what: Meeting management software for 1:1s and team meetings
competitors.traction_then: Customers included Shopify, Hopin, GoCardless and Stanford per Oct 2021 coverage
competitors.funding_then: Raised a $24M Series A in Oct 2021 after an $8.75M seed in 2019

technical_complexity.rationale: Agenda and notes web app with calendar and tool integrations (Atlassian Marketplace, Chrome extension); standard SaaS engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Stored meeting history and OKR links give some stickiness, but meeting agenda tools were numerous and easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Performance platforms like Lattice and 15Five already offered 1:1 features per review pages; the company later rebranded into an AI meeting assistant, Spinach AI, in Oct 2024.

market_need_then: The YC page claims over 100k managers used the app at companies like Netflix, LinkedIn and Facebook, and Fellow's $24M Series A in Oct 2021 shows investor interest in the category.

branding.domain_note: Used hypercontext.com, which now redirects to spinach.ai.

rebrands.why: Not stated; BDC portfolio page says Hypercontext was previously Soapbox
Company blog says Hypercontext is now Spinach AI; reason for the change not given in the snippet

branding.community_and_virality: Hacker News launch post in July 2021 and Product Hunt listing; no merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is abstract and also used by an unrelated security trademark; it was renamed twice, which suggests the name did not carry the product.

pivots.from: Meeting agendas, notes and OKRs for managers
pivots.to: AI meeting assistant under the Spinach AI name

outcome_analysis: Hypercontext (previously Soapbox) reached a claimed 100k managers and small seed funding, then in October 2024 became part of Spinach AI with accounts migrated. The YC inactive label reflects the rename rather than a documented shutdown, so no failure cause applies, and the company's continued backing by YC, Zoom and Atlassian per the Spinach site suggests the team continued under a new brand.
notes: Funding rests on two databases and no press release: CB Insights shows a $0.13M seed on 2021-08-31 (total $130K across two rounds); Seedtable shows $360.5K total with a $125K pre-seed in Aug 2021 and a $235.54K round with an unreliable date, recorded as other. The $130K seed matches the YC standard deal size. The CEO is the only founder named; the YC page mentions a CTO in snippets but no name was found. hypercontext.com redirects to spinach.ai, whose page does not mention Hypercontext, but Spinach's own blog and FAQ say Hypercontext is now Spinach AI. PitchBook describes Spinach AI as formerly SoapBox, Hypercontext. YC status Inactive is consistent with the brand migration, not a sale; no acquirer is documented. Fellow's source is dated October 2021, a few months after the Summer 2021 batch.
